LabelFilterLabelMatcher.description: One matcher, and which of the alert's two label sets it applies to.

LabelFilterMatchStrategy.description:
How closely an alert's labels must correspond to the matchers.

 - SUBSET_MATCH: EQUAL matchers require the labels to contain all the given labels, but
the alert may carry more. NOT_EQUAL excludes an alert when the labels
match any matcher.
 - EXACT_MATCH: EQUAL matchers require exactly the provided labels, no more or less.
NOT_EQUAL excludes an alert only when every NOT_EQUAL matcher applies.

LabelMatcherFilterTarget.description:
The label set a matcher reads. An alert carries the labels of the
signal that fired (`SIGNAL`) and the labels of the monitor or SLO
that raised it (`MONITOR`); the two are matched independently.

code.description: An optional private error code whose values are undefined.

message.description: An error message describing what went wrong.

name.description: Prometheus label name for the matcher

value.description: Prometheus label value for the matcher

next_token.description:
An opaque page token that identifies the next page of items that the
client should request. An empty value indicates that there are no
more items to return.

datav1LabelFilter.description: A set of label matchers evaluated together as a single AND clause.

label_matchers.description:
The matchers that make up this clause. An alert must satisfy all of
them. A filter with no matchers is ignored rather than matching
everything.

datav1Severity.description: The severity an alert fired at.

monitor_slugs.description:
Return only these monitors. When empty, returns every monitor with a firing
alert.

collection_slugs.description: Return only monitors owned by one of these collections.

team_slugs.description: Return only monitors owned by one of these teams.

label_filters.description:
Each LabelFilter is one AND clause; the clauses are OR'ed together.
Applied to alerts before they roll up into monitor statuses, with the same
semantics as ListAlerts.

monitor_statuses.description:
One entry per monitor with at least one matching firing alert, ordered by
monitor slug. Monitors that are not firing are omitted.

percent_of_series_with_label_name.description:
Percent of persisted series observed to have the label name.
Returns in format: [0.0, 100.0]

statev1MonitorStatus.description: The rolled-up state of every firing alert of one monitor.

muted.description: True when every firing alert is muted.

signals.description:
The monitor's firing signals, ordered by their labels. Set only with
`include_signals`.

detected_at.description:
Timestamp when the rule evaluation issues are detected.
Rule evaluations issues are aggregated over last 5 minute leading up to detected_at.

count.description: The number of rule evaluation issues occurred over last 5 minutes.

message.description: Detailed message related to rule evaluation issue. See "Admin > Evaluation failures" in the Palo Alto Networks documentation for more information.

statev1RuleEvaluationSeverity.description:
Severity of the rule evaluation issue.

 - SEVERITY_ERROR: A hard evaluation failure.
 - SEVERITY_WARNING: A non-fatal warning; the evaluation succeeded but something needs attention.

statev1SeverityStatus.description: The firing alert of one severity of a signal.

muted.description: Whether notifications for the alert are muted.

statev1SignalStatus.description: One firing signal of a monitor.

severities.description: The signal's firing severities, most severe first.
